label: TP
reason: Alert 1 alert-TP: User input from request.getParameter flows directly to connectHttpByHostname(host) at line 44. While resolveHost(host) validates the IP is non-private, this only blocks localhost/site-local/link-local addresses—not external IPs, cloud metadata services, or DNS rebinding attacks. The resolved sink value at line 44 is the user-supplied host parameter, which remains attacker-controllable. The sleep(50) adds a timing gap between DNS resolution and connection, increasing SSRF risk further.

evidence.note: User param flows to host var, validated by resolveHost(), then connectHttpByHostname(host) executes with unresolved attacker-controlled host
